on:

        options:
          - 'true'
          - 'false'
      run_db_tests:
        description: 'Set this parameter to "true" to run database related test cases'
        required: false
        default: 'false'
        type: choice
        options:
          - 'true'
          - 'false'
      test_suite:
        description: 'Enter specific test suite. E.g. domain, linode_client'
        required: false
      use_minimal_test_account:
        description: 'Indicate whether to use a minimal test account with limited resources for testing. Defaults to "false"'
        required: false
        default: 'false'

        description: 'Specify commit hash to test. This value is mandatory to ensure the tests run against a specific commit'
        required: true
        default: ''

        description: 'Specify the Python version to use for running tests. Leave empty to use the default Python version configured in the environment'

      run-eol-python-version:
        description: 'Indicates whether to run tests using an End-of-Life (EOL) Python version. Defaults to "false". Choose "true" to include tests for deprecated Python versions'

        default: 'false'
        type: choice
        options:
          - 'true'
          - 'false'
      test_report_upload:

        required: false
        default: 'false'
        options:
          - 'true'

  integration-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: 'recursive'

      - name: Clone Repository without SHA
        if: ${{ inputs.sha == '' }}

        uses: actions/setup-python@v7

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
